label: D-Link DGS-1210-10
description: D-Link DGS-1210-10 (Rev F) smart managed switch: 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45, 2x 100/1000 Mbps SFP cages, 20 Gbps switching capacity, 14.88 Mpps, fanless, 280 x 126 x 44 mm.

fabric.note: 20 Gbps switching capacity and 14.88 Mpps maximum 64-byte forwarding rate for the DGS-1210-10, from the DGS-1210 Series Rev F datasheet specification table (https://www.dlink.com/us/en/-/media/business_products/dgs/dgs-1210/datasheet/dgs1210seriesrevfdatasheet211enus.pdf). 10 ports x 2 Gbps full duplex, so an RJ45/SFP combo pair counts once whichever medium is in use.

notes: Ports, per the DGS-1210 Series Rev F datasheet (hardware Rev. F, 2.11 EN US, 05-SEP-2018): 8 x 10/100/1000BASE-T plus 2 x 100/1000 Mbps SFP cages. 8K MAC entries, 256 static MAC entries, 4.1 Mbits packet buffer, DDR3 128 MB CPU memory, 32 MB flash, 256 static VLAN groups (VID 1-4094), 802.1D/802.1w/802.1s STP, 802.3ad LACP (8 groups of up to 8 ports), jumbo frames to 10,000 bytes, and 124 IPv4 / 50 IPv6 static routes over 4 IP interfaces - static routing, not a routing protocol, which is what puts this in the L3-lite class. Management is web GUI, compact CLI over Telnet, SNMP v1/v2c/v3 and D-Link Network Assistant; no model in the line has a serial console port (the console row in the datasheet is an LED, not a port). Dual software images and dual configuration files. Fanless (0 dB(A), Fans: No), 280 x 126 x 44 mm, 0.98 kg, 6.31 W at 100 V. The SFP cages are 100/1000 Mbps only, not 1/10G, so their speedCaps are 100 and 1000. Management is web GUI, compact CLI over Telnet, SNMP v1/v2c/v3 and D-Link Network Assistant; there is no serial console port on this model, only a Console LED, and the datasheet lists dual software images and dual configuration files. Source: https://www.dlink.com/us/en/-/media/business_products/dgs/dgs-1210/datasheet/dgs1210seriesrevfdatasheet211enus.pdf
